title: How Mpower Solar Cut Change Orders by 80% and Doubled Site Survey Capacity | Aurora Solar
markdown:
Mpower Solar, a family-owned installer based in Brooklyn, switched from a limited design tool that couldn’t handle complex NYC rooftops to Aurora’s all-in-one platform. With Aurora, the team now creates proposals 3× faster, completes site surveys in half the time, and has reduced change orders by 80%. Seamless HubSpot integration also eliminated 20 minutes of manual CRM entry per project and removed costly data errors. The result is a more efficient, scalable operation where sales reps close faster, designers focus on new projects instead of revisions, and customers get a smoother experience from start to finish.
